title: Extension Updater
description: Discover, install, and batch-update Cove extensions from rolling manifest feeds, GitHub releases, and static ZIP URLs.

blocks.text: Open Extension Updater from the navigation sidebar to compare your installed extensions against remote manifest feeds, GitHub repositories, and static ZIP packages.

items: Click Check All to query all enabled extension sources concurrently.
Filter discovered extensions by status (Updates, Installed, Not Installed), category (Downloaders, Scrapers, Tools & UI), or search keyword.
Click Update All to batch-install all available updates (updating Extension Updater itself last), or click Update / Install on individual extensions.

rows: Multi-extension repositories publishing a rolling latest-manifest.json catalog
Single or multi-extension GitHub repositories using release tags and .zip assets
Direct URL to a rolling or versioned extension .zip package (with ETag caching)
